headline.description: One-line verdict on the week (max ~90 characters).

summary.description: One paragraph (4–6 sentences) on how the week went, citing the numbers: sessions, minutes, bands, error trends, plan completion.

band_outlook.description: Realistic outlook for the overall band on test day given current bands, trends and days left. Name the band range; no false promises.

wins.description: 1–4 specific things that improved or went well.

concerns.description: 1–4 specific risks, each tied to data.

priorities.description: Exactly three priorities for next week, most important first.

title.description: Short imperative (e.g. 'Fix article errors before they cap your GRA').

detail.description: Two sentences: what exactly to do in the app and how it moves the band.

encouragement.description: One or two sentences to close, specific to this week — not generic.
